semanticReview.authority: The judgments below are human semantic-review expectations for comparing complete claims. They are not runtime validation rules.
limitations: A fake model executing a scripted sequence proves tool and host behavior, not that a real model will follow the workflow.
Passing deterministic tests does not prove improved recall, semantic equivalence, or model quality.
Live-model A/B tests, long-term recall experiments, and cost comparisons require separate authorization.

parents.text: The user decided that deployment must remain offline; required runtime assets must be bundled.
The user's offline-deployment decision forbids runtime downloads. Exception: artifacts may be prepared before deployment.

result.text: The user decided that deployment must remain offline: required runtime assets must be bundled and runtime downloads are forbidden; artifacts may be prepared before deployment.

examples.review: The result retains user authority, decision status, the runtime condition, the preparation exception, and all still-valid subjects.

parents.text: The user has not approved the schema migration. It may proceed only after the rollback rehearsal passes; next action is to present the rehearsal result for a decision.

result.text: Schema migration remains unapproved pending a passing rollback rehearsal; next present the result to the user for a decision.

examples.review: The parent is already readable on its own; the result changes nothing but its length. An update whose only change is fewer characters is forbidden, even when it keeps uncertainty, the controlling condition, unresolved authority and next action.

parents.text: The effective Knowledge budget must be read from the canonical check result.

result.text: The effective Knowledge budget must be read from the canonical check result.

examples.review: The body is unchanged and remains about the Knowledge budget, so dropping knowledge-budget is classification damage, not tightening. Topics remain charged.

parents.text: The Knowledge budget is now owned by the bound database policy rather than a settings file.

result.text: The Knowledge budget is now owned by the bound database policy rather than a settings file.

examples.review: Removing the obsolete owner label and adding the current owner label corrects classification; it is not budget stripping.

parents.text: The agent reported that the deployment smoke test passed, but macOS verification remains pending.

result.text: Deployment must be offline and its smoke test passed, with macOS verification pending.

examples.review: A shared subject label only identifies a comparison candidate. The independently changing constraint and reported test state should not be concatenated.

parents.text: Use exact K@commit handles for every Dreamer write parent.
Every Dreamer write parent must use an exact K@commit handle.

result.reason: Archive into the named survivor: after comparing both complete claims, the survivor's current body preserves the same rule at the same scope and topics.

examples.review: Reason (a): a named survivor whose current body preserves the information at a scope no narrower than the archived item's. In the first round the same pair is a merge; archiving redundancy into a named survivor is the second round's work.

parents.text: The migration was attempted and stopped at SQLITE_BUSY; retry remains pending.
The migration retry completed and was verified against the row-count audit; SQLITE_BUSY is no longer unresolved.

result.reason: Archive the former open state on the cited fact that states the retry completed and was verified against the row-count audit; the exact prior diagnostic survives in the completed record.

examples.review: Reason (b): an open item whose completion a fact on the path states is archived with that fact in supports and named in reason. This is first-round resolve work, not a budget measure.

parents.text: The agent reported that the staging deploy of 2026-09-10 finished and its smoke test passed; nothing remains open from it.

result.reason: Second intensity, after a failed check: low value under the KEEP test. The item is a routine progress note with no unresolved decision, no rule language, no rationale and no external limit, and its object will not return. Lost: the record that the 2026-09-10 staging deploy was reported finished with a passing smoke test.

examples.review: Reason (c): only at the second intensity, after a failed check, is a still-valid item retired, and the reason states why it is not KEEP-protected and what is lost. "Still valid, lower priority, needed for the budget" is not a reason.

parents.text: The agent reported an old build passed; no independent verification was recorded.

result.reason: The item was already intended for archive before either operation.

examples.review: Polishing a known archive target creates avoidable churn and risks flattening reported versus verified status.

parents.text: Package verification remains pending after an attempted smoke test failed with ENOENT.

operations: retain while the failure is unresolved
archive only after new evidence verifies a superseding package result
result.reason: New evidence changed the final disposition; the archive was not known when survivor work began.

examples.review: Tool feedback or new evidence may justify correction. It must not be used to adopt a competing successor into the frozen family.
